crossRefs.note: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.
You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and…
“They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.
They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and…

translations.web: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.
translations.bsb: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so that the poles are on two sides of the altar when it is carried.
translations.kjv: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear
translations.asv: And the staves thereof shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, in bearing it.
